description: This file defines the PlotAreaMapper class responsible for mapping or transforming properties from a PDFsharp Charting PlotArea object to a MigraDoc rendering model PlotArea object. It includes methods for mapping object properties such as paddings and formats.

classes.name: PlotAreaMapper
classes.description: A class responsible for mapping properties from a PdfSharp Charting PlotArea to a MigraDoc document model PlotArea.

methods.name: MapObject
methods.description: Maps properties from a PdfSharp PlotArea object to a MigraDoc PlotArea object, including paddings and formats.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Static method that creates an instance of PlotAreaMapper and calls MapObject to perform the mapping.
